title: 9–20 February - 50th Berlin International Film Festival
text: The 50th annual Berlin International Film Festival was held from February 9 to 20, 2000. The festival opened with The Million Dollar Hotel by Wim Wenders.

title: Germany in the Eurovision Song Contest 2000
text: Germany was represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 2000 with the song "Wadde hadde dudde da?" written and performed by Stefan Raab. The German participating broadcaster on behalf of ARD, Norddeutscher Rundfunk, organised the national final Countdown Grand Prix Eurovision 2000 in order to select their entry for the contest.
wiki: Germany in the Eurovision Song Contest 2000

title: Schleswig-Holstein state election, 2000
text: The 2000 Schleswig-Holstein state election was held on 27 February 2000 to elect the members of the Landtag of Schleswig-Holstein. The incumbent coalition government of the Social Democratic Party and The Greens led by Minister-President Heide Simonis retained its majority and continued in office.

title: North Rhine-Westphalia state election, 2000
text: The 2000 North Rhine-Westphalia state election was held on 14 May 2000 to elect the 13th Landtag of North Rhine-Westphalia. The outgoing government was a coalition of the Social Democratic Party and The Greens led by Minister-President Wolfgang Clement.

title: Air France Flight 4590 crashes near Paris, France shortly after taking off, killing 109 people mostly Germans, and 4 on the ground.
text: Air France Flight 4590 was an international charter flight from Paris to New York. On 25 July 2000, a Concorde passenger jet operating the flight crashed shortly after takeoff, killing all 109 people on board and four on the ground.

title: 2000 German Grand Prix at Hockenheimring
text: The 2000 German Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race contested on 30 July 2000, at the Hockenheimring in Baden-Württemberg, Germany, in front of 102,000 people. It was the 62nd German Grand Prix and the 11th round of the 2000 Formula One World Championship.

title: German company ProSiebenSat.1 Media was founded.
text: ProSiebenSat.1 Media SE is a German mass media and digital company based in Unterföhring near Munich. MediaForEurope owns 75.61% of the company.

title: Date unknown: Fusion of German company VEBA and German company VIAG to German company E.ON
text: E.ON SE is a German multinational electric utility company based in Essen, Germany. It operates as one of the world's largest investor-owned electric utility service providers.

title: 2000 FIRA Women's European Championship
text: The 2000 FIRA Women's European Championship was the fifth edition of the tournament. It saw virtually the same format as 1997.

title: 2000 Sparkassen Cup (tennis)
text: The 2000 Sparkassen Cup was a tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts in Leipzig, Germany. It was part of the Tier II category of the 2000 WTA Tour.

title: “Maschen-Draht-Zaun” by Stefan Raab
text: "Maschen-Draht-Zaun" is a country music song by German entertainer Stefan Raab, released in 1999. The inspiration for the song comes from his TV show TV total, where short (often involuntarily) humorous clips from other German TV shows are shown.

title: “Join Me” by 24 January
text: "Join Me in Death" is a single by Finnish gothic rock band HIM, taken from their second studio album, Razorblade Romance. It was also released under the condensed title of "Join Me".

title: “My Heart Goes Boom (La Di Da Da)” by 21 February
text: "My Heart Goes Boom" is a song by German-French dance-pop act French Affair. It was released in January 2000 as the lead single from their debut album, Desire (2000).

title: “American Pie” by Madonna
text: "American Pie" is a song by the American singer and songwriter Don McLean. It was a commercial success and cultural touchstone, notable for its extensive and ambiguous lyrics about America's changing society in the 1950s and 1960s.

title: “Maria Maria” by Santana featuring The Product G&B
text: "Maria Maria" is a song by American rock band Santana featuring the Product G&B, included on Santana's 18th studio album, Supernatural. The song was written by Wyclef Jean, Jerry "Wonda" Duplessis, Carlos Santana, Karl Perazzo, and Raul Rekow, while Jean and Duplessis produced it.

title: “Anton aus Tirol” by 17 April
text: "Anton aus Tirol" is a song by Austrian musician Anton featuring DJ Ötzi. Written by Vili Petrič, it was first recorded by the German musical group Walter & die bunten Vögel and released as a single in 1991, but this version did not achieve success.

title: “Freestyler” by 5 June
text: "Freestyler" is a song by Finnish hip hop group Bomfunk MC's. It was released in Finland on 30 October 1999 as the third single from their debut studio album, In Stereo, and was released internationally in February 2000.

title: “Around the World (La La La La La)” by 24 July
text: "Around the World" is a song by German-based international Eurodance group ATC (an abbreviation of "A Touch of Class"). The song is a cover of the Russian hit "Pesenka" by Ruki Vverh!

title: “Lucky” by 4 September
text: "Lucky" is a song by American singer Britney Spears from her second studio album, Oops!... I Did It Again.

title: “The Spirit of the Hawk” by Rednex
text: "The Spirit of the Hawk" is a song by Swedish musical group Rednex released from their second album, Farm Out. The lyrics include the spoken lines "My people, some of them, have run away to the hills, and have no shelter, no food.

title: “Es ist geil ein Arschloch zu sein” by Christian
text: "Es ist geil ein Arschloch zu sein" is a song by German singer and Big Brother Germany contestant Christian. Following his brief and controversial tenure on the programme, Christian quit the show and capitalised on his notoriety in Germany to record the track, which was written by Steve van Velvet and produced by Bülent Aris in Hamburg, Germany.
